finite_question.support_level: YES: NEMO authoritative client list separately identifies 2018-07-04aRagexe and 2018-07-04aRagexeRE. This is support-history evidence, not a required patch recommendation or qualification of supplied executable bytes.

finite_question.availability_verdict: UNKNOWN for actually available plain, legitimately usable compatible complete executable/resources bundle. Catalogue listing is not successful asset retrieval, entitlement, unprotected status, matching hash or human login evidence.

distinctions.claim: The official rAthena public header auto-selects RE in the older range only below 20180704, and defines PACKETVER_MAIN_NUM when RE is absent. This confirms nomenclature, not a newly verified compiled package or GUI compatibility.

MAIN/Ragexe versus RE/RagexeRE is packet/client family; pre-renewal versus renewal is the independent ruleset flag in the supplied installed-profile report. Do not infer RE from the word Renewal in a publisher URL or from ruleset preference.
distinctions.provenance: Header source plus supplied local review; no new compiler/world verification.

distinctions.claim: The existing headless profile proves no compatible GUI bundle availability; it may have been chosen without a corresponding qualified human bundle.
distinctions.provenance: Inference from supplied local review and current artifact gap.

paths.required_user_input: Exact local directory/archive location of a legitimately held plain 2018-07-04aRagexe bundle, including original/known patch provenance and complete matching resources.
paths.qualification: Separately scoped offline identification of actual PE family/date and tool-computed hashes; documented NEMO support for the exact bytes/patch revision; unobfuscated output matching the compiled mappings; asset completeness and exe-specific Lua/LUB compatibility; executable-recognized test-world clientinfo. Do not run or patch protected uaRO files.

paths.required_user_input: Identify a Gravity/licensed publisher distribution or support-provided archive for the exact historical MAIN executable/resources, or provide an already legally obtained official installer/archive location and provenance.
paths.qualification: Official publisher client-download page is identifiable; it does not establish that the pinned historical Korean MAIN executable is included. Current iRO client must not be assumed compatible. No old official binary archive or redistribution permission was established.

NEMO authoritative list/catalogue identifies exact MAIN candidate; Use Custom DLL support table gives one exact MAIN success row (turn0search8), whereas BookingButton records an exact MAIN failure (turn0search10). Therefore support is patch-specific, not universal. No asset link was followed; public listing is not a license grant.

configuration_public_shape.description: Official rAthena wiki documents clientinfo XML connection address, port and version. Exact file selection/lookup and full field values require qualification against the supplied executable and its documented patches; sample values were not adopted.
configuration_public_shape.version_warning: XML version is documented against login client_version_to_connect, not PACKETVER 20180704.
configuration_public_shape.redaction: No actual local endpoint, URL, credential, PIN or connection string is included; no XML configuration artifact was created.

precise_missing_input: Location/artifact of a legitimately held plain 2018-07-04aRagexe bundle and matching resources/provenance, or selection/identification of an official historical distribution that supplies it. Test-world recognized client configuration remains absent and requires later scoped preparation. This is missing artifact input, not routine consent.
migration: Any different client date or RE family requires a new scoped decision and rebuilding/requalification of compiled mappings, actor layouts and manifests; no silent PACKETVER/server-family change.
parent_continuation: Human GUI remains blocked; independent bot-shop development may continue without claiming GUI or broader E2E acceptance.
